snippets.output: Pepto-Bismol is a brand-name medication that contains bismuth subsalicylate as its active ingredient.
Bismuth subsalicylate is an antacid and anti-diarrheal medication used to treat various gastrointestinal symptoms, including heartburn, indigestion, nausea, and diarrhea.
Bismuth subsalicylate works by coating the stomach and intestines with a protective barrier, reducing inflammation, and slowing the movement of food through the digestive system.
Bismuth subsalicylate is used to treat traveler’s diarrhea, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and stomach ulcers.
Pepto-Bismol is available over-the-counter and comes in various forms, including liquid, tablets, and chewable tablets.
Pepto-Bismol is not suitable for everyone, including people with certain medical conditions such as bleeding disorders, kidney disease, or stomach ulcers.
Pepto-Bismol is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women without consulting a healthcare provider.
